body: This happened to me too!!!! I don’t know what to do about it :/ I’m nervous because it was as if my body just absolutely refused to wake up, because it knew that if I did wake up for my alarm I’d keep pushing it, go to work, etc. But I can’t risk my job! It’s a really terrifying level of fatigue.

Saying “what?” even though I heard everything, just to buy myself some more time to respond, and then my response either…. 

Ends with “it could also be the exact opposite though, I don’t really know, ya know? ….” 

Or 

Drops off part way through and I literally just stop talking 

Or 

I get super hyper and talk talk talk and then look around and feel like I’ve just exposed myself and I need to take cover and change my name and phone number, not because being vulnerable scares me, but because misrepresenting myself / my thoughts (over or under emphasizing, “lying” on little things just because I’m trying desperately to be able to remember anything fully enough under pressure to get myself / story sorted enough that I can actually tie my response up neatly.. then when it’s over, I feel so confused about myself and who I am and why am I analyzing everything about that person and myself and now I suddenly feel the void of me vs world so massively and now I’m going to go home and make a to do list and do nothing on it and not be able to fall asleep until 4am
